sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on a monthly bases as 
indicated by M1 as indicated in the title block.

The technical specification of the 
pump FN 135010 SIZE-1450 RPM-1.1 KW

The 
first draft initiated & tested by eng. Abd El Mohsen Mohammed general manager of Nag 
Hammadi Hyd. PS, and certified by by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC 
inspection and quality control general director.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category.
